title: 金鯱賞の後に・動けない、動かない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I somehow manage to finish the Kinko Sho. Some of my fans call out to me after the race, but how can I face them in this state?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I stand there paralyzed, Sweep butts in and demands that I act more like myself… But if I do that, I won't be like a proper princess, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing my hesitation, Trainer asks me to think about my ideal self once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My convictions are still wavering, but one thing's for sure—I can't enter the Victoria Mile like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My idol, King, is running in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, which is being held at the same time as a Princess Fighter show. Maybe if I enter too, something will change…
